G1_unambiguity.justification: The determinant condition is explicitly defined, and with frequencies restricted to 1, 2, and 3 it unambiguously requires the endpoints of every conduit to have different frequencies.

G2_completeness.justification: The rewritten statement specifies the input bounds and format, valid frequency values, feasibility output, lexicographic tie-break rule, and all relevant edge conditions.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The determinant is a Vandermonde determinant that is nonzero exactly when the two endpoint frequencies differ, so the rewrite asks for precisely the same proper three-coloring and lexicographically smallest assignment as the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, although the elaborate quantum-grid and calibration terminology makes it more contrived than the straightforward original framing.
